prompt: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Compare co-purchase patterns across store locations and seasonal periods to reveal location- and season-specific buying behavior.
title: Co-Purchase Bundle Analysis
summary: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Compare co-purchase patterns across store locations and seasonal periods to reveal location- and season-specific buying behavior.
executed_sql_queries:
WITH total_orders AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_order_count
  FROM retail.orders o
), pair_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
    p1.sku AS sku_1,
    p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
    p2.sku AS sku_2,
    COUNT(DISTINCT oi1.order_id) AS co_purchase_frequency
  FROM retail.order_items oi1
  JOIN retail.order_items oi2
    ON oi1.order_id = oi2.order_id
   AND oi1.product_id < oi2.product_id
  JOIN retail.products p1
    ON oi1.product_id = p1.product_id
  JOIN retail.products p2
    ON oi2.product_id = p2.product_id
  GROUP BY p1.product_name, p1.sku, p2.product_name, p2.sku
)
SELECT
  pc.product_name_1,
  pc.sku_1,
  pc.product_name_2,
  pc.sku_2,
  pc.co_purchase_frequency,
  ROUND(100.0 * pc.co_purchase_frequency / NULLIF(to2.total_order_count, 0), 2) AS share_of_orders,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pc.co_purchase_frequency DESC, pc.product_name_1, pc.product_name_2) AS bundle_rank
FROM pair_counts pc
CROSS JOIN total_orders to2
ORDER BY pc.co_purchase_frequency DESC, pc.product_name_1, pc.product_name_2
LIMIT 50;

WITH order_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        oi1.order_id,
        LEAST(oi1.product_id, oi2.product_id) AS product_id_1,
        GREATEST(oi1.product_id, oi2.product_id) AS product_id_2
    FROM retail.order_items oi1
    JOIN retail.order_items oi2
      ON oi1.order_id = oi2.order_id
     AND oi1.product_id < oi2.product_id
),
overall_pairs AS (
    SELECT product_id_1, product_id_2, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS overall_co_purchase_frequency
    FROM order_pairs
    GROUP BY product_id_1, product_id_2
),
overall_orders AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM retail.orders
),
store_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        CASE
            WHEN s.is_online THEN 'Online'
            WHEN s.store_name LIKE '%Seattle%' THEN 'Seattle'
            WHEN s.store_name LIKE '%Bellevue%' THEN 'Bellevue'
            WHEN s.store_name LIKE '%Tacoma%' THEN 'Tacoma'
            WHEN s.store_name LIKE '%Spokane%' THEN 'Spokane'
            WHEN s.store_name LIKE '%Everett%' THEN 'Everett'
            WHEN s.store_name LIKE '%Redmond%' THEN 'Redmond'
            WHEN s.store_name LIKE '%Kirkland%' THEN 'Kirkland'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS store_location
    FROM retail.orders o
    JOIN retail.stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
),
store_pair_counts AS (
    SELECT
        so.store_location,
        op.product_id_1,
        op.product_id_2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT op.order_id) AS store_level_co_purchase_frequency
    FROM order_pairs op
    JOIN store_orders so ON op.order_id = so.order_id
    WHERE so.store_location IN ('Seattle','Bellevue','Tacoma','Spokane','Everett','Redmond','Kirkland','Online')
    GROUP BY so.store_location, op.product_id_1, op.product_id_2
),
store_order_counts AS (
    SELECT store_location, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS store_total_orders
    FROM store_orders
    WHERE store_location IN ('Seattle','Bellevue','Tacoma','Spokane','Everett','Redmond','Kirkland','Online')
    GROUP BY store_location
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        spc.store_location,
        p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
        p1.sku AS sku_1,
        p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
        p2.sku AS sku_2,
        spc.store_level_co_purchase_frequency,
        ROUND(100.0 * spc.store_level_co_purchase_frequency / soc.store_total_orders, 2) AS store_level_share_of_orders,
        op.overall_co_purchase_frequency,
        ROUND(100.0 * op.overall_co_purchase_frequency / oo.total_orders, 2) AS overall_share_of_orders,
        ROUND(100.0 * spc.store_level_co_purchase_frequency / soc.store_total_orders - 100.0 * op.overall_co_purchase_frequency / oo.total_orders, 2) AS deviation_from_overall_share,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY spc.store_location
            ORDER BY ABS(100.0 * spc.store_level_co_purchase_frequency / soc.store_total_orders - 100.0 * op.overall_co_purchase_frequency / oo.total_orders) DESC,
                     spc.store_level_co_purchase_frequency DESC,
                     p1.product_name,
                     p2.product_name
        ) AS rn
    FROM store_pair_counts spc
    JOIN overall_pairs op ON spc.product_id_1 = op.product_id_1 AND spc.product_id_2 = op.product_id_2
    JOIN retail.products p1 ON spc.product_id_1 = p1.product_id
    JOIN retail.products p2 ON spc.product_id_2 = p2.product_id
    JOIN store_order_counts soc ON spc.store_location = soc.store_location
    CROSS JOIN overall_orders oo
)
SELECT *
FROM scored
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY store_location, rn;

WITH order_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        oi1.order_id,
        oi1.product_id AS product_id_1,
        oi2.product_id AS product_id_2
    FROM retail.order_items oi1
    JOIN retail.order_items oi2
      ON oi1.order_id = oi2.order_id
     AND oi1.product_id < oi2.product_id
),
overall_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        op.product_id_1,
        op.product_id_2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT op.order_id) AS overall_co_purchase_frequency
    FROM order_pairs op
    GROUP BY op.product_id_1, op.product_id_2
),
total_orders AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_order_count
    FROM retail.orders
)
SELECT
    p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
    p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
    o.overall_co_purchase_frequency,
    ROUND(100.0 * o.overall_co_purchase_frequency / t.total_order_count, 2) AS overall_share_of_orders
FROM overall_pairs o
JOIN retail.products p1 ON p1.product_id = o.product_id_1
JOIN retail.products p2 ON p2.product_id = o.product_id_2
CROSS JOIN total_orders t
ORDER BY o.overall_co_purchase_frequency DESC, product_name_1, product_name_2
LIMIT 10;

WITH order_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        oi1.order_id,
        oi1.product_id AS product_id_1,
        oi2.product_id AS product_id_2
    FROM retail.order_items oi1
    JOIN retail.order_items oi2
      ON oi1.order_id = oi2.order_id
     AND oi1.product_id < oi2.product_id
),
overall_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        product_id_1,
        product_id_2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS overall_co_purchase_frequency
    FROM order_pairs
    GROUP BY product_id_1, product_id_2
),
top_pairs AS (
    SELECT product_id_1, product_id_2, overall_co_purchase_frequency
    FROM overall_pairs
    ORDER BY overall_co_purchase_frequency DESC, product_id_1, product_id_2
    LIMIT 10
),
seasonal_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS season_month,
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_date) AS season_quarter,
        op.product_id_1,
        op.product_id_2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT op.order_id) AS seasonal_co_purchase_frequency
    FROM order_pairs op
    JOIN retail.orders o
      ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date), DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_date), op.product_id_1, op.product_id_2
),
month_totals AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS season_month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders_in_month
    FROM retail.orders
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_date) AS season_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders_in_quarter
    FROM retail.orders
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_date)
),
total_orders AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_order_count
    FROM retail.orders
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN sp.season_month IS NOT NULL THEN 'month' ELSE 'quarter' END AS seasonal_period_type,
    COALESCE(sp.season_month::text, sp.season_quarter::text) AS seasonal_period,
    p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
    p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
    sp.seasonal_co_purchase_frequency,
    ROUND(100.0 * sp.seasonal_co_purchase_frequency / CASE WHEN sp.season_month IS NOT NULL THEN mt.total_orders_in_month ELSE qt.total_orders_in_quarter END, 2) AS seasonal_share_of_orders,
    tp.overall_co_purchase_frequency,
    ROUND(100.0 * tp.overall_co_purchase_frequency / t.total_order_count, 2) AS overall_share_of_orders,
    sp.seasonal_co_purchase_frequency - tp.overall_co_purchase_frequency AS deviation_from_overall_frequency,
    ROUND((100.0 * sp.seasonal_co_purchase_frequency / CASE WHEN sp.season_month IS NOT NULL THEN mt.total_orders_in_month ELSE qt.total_orders_in_quarter END) - (100.0 * tp.overall_co_purchase_frequency / t.total_order_count), 2) AS deviation_from_overall_share
FROM seasonal_pairs sp
JOIN top_pairs tp
  ON tp.product_id_1 = sp.product_id_1
 AND tp.product_id_2 = sp.product_id_2
JOIN retail.products p1 ON p1.product_id = sp.product_id_1
JOIN retail.products p2 ON p2.product_id = sp.product_id_2
CROSS JOIN total_orders t
LEFT JOIN month_totals mt ON mt.season_month = sp.season_month
LEFT JOIN quarter_totals qt ON qt.season_quarter = sp.season_quarter
WHERE sp.season_month IS NOT NULL OR sp.season_quarter IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY seasonal_period_type, seasonal_period, sp.seasonal_co_purchase_frequency DESC, product_name_1, product_name_2
LIMIT 20;

WITH order_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        oi1.order_id,
        oi1.product_id AS product_id_1,
        oi2.product_id AS product_id_2
    FROM retail.order_items oi1
    JOIN retail.order_items oi2
      ON oi1.order_id = oi2.order_id
     AND oi1.product_id < oi2.product_id
),
overall_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        product_id_1,
        product_id_2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS overall_co_purchase_frequency
    FROM order_pairs
    GROUP BY product_id_1, product_id_2
),
top_pairs AS (
    SELECT product_id_1, product_id_2, overall_co_purchase_frequency
    FROM overall_pairs
    ORDER BY overall_co_purchase_frequency DESC, product_id_1, product_id_2
    LIMIT 10
),
quarter_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_date) AS season_quarter,
        op.product_id_1,
        op.product_id_2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT op.order_id) AS seasonal_co_purchase_frequency
    FROM order_pairs op
    JOIN retail.orders o
      ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_date), op.product_id_1, op.product_id_2
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_date) AS season_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders_in_quarter
    FROM retail.orders
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_date)
),
total_orders AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_order_count
    FROM retail.orders
)
SELECT
    'quarter' AS seasonal_period_type,
    qp.season_quarter::text AS seasonal_period,
    p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
    p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
    qp.seasonal_co_purchase_frequency,
    ROUND(100.0 * qp.seasonal_co_purchase_frequency / qt.total_orders_in_quarter, 2) AS seasonal_share_of_orders,
    tp.overall_co_purchase_frequency,
    ROUND(100.0 * tp.overall_co_purchase_frequency / t.total_order_count, 2) AS overall_share_of_orders,
    qp.seasonal_co_purchase_frequency - tp.overall_co_purchase_frequency AS deviation_from_overall_frequency,
    ROUND((100.0 * qp.seasonal_co_purchase_frequency / qt.total_orders_in_quarter) - (100.0 * tp.overall_co_purchase_frequency / t.total_order_count), 2) AS deviation_from_overall_share
FROM quarter_pairs qp
JOIN top_pairs tp
  ON tp.product_id_1 = qp.product_id_1
 AND tp.product_id_2 = qp.product_id_2
JOIN retail.products p1 ON p1.product_id = qp.product_id_1
JOIN retail.products p2 ON p2.product_id = qp.product_id_2
JOIN quarter_totals qt ON qt.season_quarter = qp.season_quarter
CROSS JOIN total_orders t
ORDER BY qp.season_quarter, qp.seasonal_co_purchase_frequency DESC, product_name_1, product_name_2
LIMIT 20;

WITH order_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        s.store_name,
        CASE
            WHEN s.store_name = 'Zava Retail Online' THEN 'Online'
            ELSE REPLACE(s.store_name, 'Zava Retail ', '')
        END AS store_location,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month_period,
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_date)::date AS quarter_period,
        p1.product_id AS product_id_1,
        p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
        p2.product_id AS product_id_2,
        p2.product_name AS product_name_2
    FROM retail.orders o
    JOIN retail.stores s
      ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN retail.order_items a
      ON a.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN retail.order_items b
      ON b.order_id = o.order_id
     AND a.product_id < b.product_id
    JOIN retail.products p1
      ON p1.product_id = a.product_id
    JOIN retail.products p2
      ON p2.product_id = b.product_id
),
overall_baseline AS (
    SELECT
        product_id_1,
        product_name_1,
        product_id_2,
        product_name_2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS overall_co_purchase_frequency,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM retail.orders) AS overall_share_of_orders
    FROM order_pairs
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
),
store_month AS (
    SELECT
        store_location,
        month_period,
        product_id_1,
        product_name_1,
        product_id_2,
        product_name_2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS store_season_cross_tab_frequency,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN order_id END) OVER (PARTITION BY store_location, month_period) AS store_season_share_of_orders
    FROM order_pairs
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
),
store_quarter AS (
    SELECT
        store_location,
        quarter_period,
        product_id_1,
        product_name_1,
        product_id_2,
        product_name_2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS store_season_cross_tab_frequency,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN order_id END) OVER (PARTITION BY store_location, quarter_period) AS store_season_share_of_orders
    FROM order_pairs
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
),
store_month_orders AS (
    SELECT store_location, month_period, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM order_pairs
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
store_quarter_orders AS (
    SELECT store_location, quarter_period, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM order_pairs
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT
    'month' AS seasonal_period_type,
    sm.store_location,
    TO_CHAR(sm.month_period, 'YYYY-MM') AS seasonal_period,
    sm.product_name_1,
    sm.product_name_2,
    sm.store_season_cross_tab_frequency,
    ROUND(sm.store_season_cross_tab_frequency * 1.0 / smo.total_orders, 6) AS store_season_share_of_orders,
    ob.overall_co_purchase_frequency,
    ROUND(ob.overall_share_of_orders, 6) AS overall_share_of_orders,
    sm.store_season_cross_tab_frequency - ob.overall_co_purchase_frequency AS deviation_from_overall_frequency,
    ROUND((sm.store_season_cross_tab_frequency * 1.0 / smo.total_orders) - ob.overall_share_of_orders, 6) AS deviation_from_overall_share
FROM store_month sm
JOIN store_month_orders smo
  ON smo.store_location = sm.store_location
 AND smo.month_period = sm.month_period
JOIN overall_baseline ob
  ON ob.product_id_1 = sm.product_id_1
 AND ob.product_id_2 = sm.product_id_2
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'quarter' AS seasonal_period_type,
    sq.store_location,
    TO_CHAR(sq.quarter_period, 'YYYY-Q') AS seasonal_period,
    sq.product_name_1,
    sq.product_name_2,
    sq.store_season_cross_tab_frequency,
    ROUND(sq.store_season_cross_tab_frequency * 1.0 / soq.total_orders, 6) AS store_season_share_of_orders,
    ob.overall_co_purchase_frequency,
    ROUND(ob.overall_share_of_orders, 6) AS overall_share_of_orders,
    sq.store_season_cross_tab_frequency - ob.overall_co_purchase_frequency AS deviation_from_overall_frequency,
    ROUND((sq.store_season_cross_tab_frequency * 1.0 / soq.total_orders) - ob.overall_share_of_orders, 6) AS deviation_from_overall_share
FROM store_quarter sq
JOIN store_quarter_orders soq
  ON soq.store_location = sq.store_location
 AND soq.quarter_period = sq.quarter_period
JOIN overall_baseline ob
  ON ob.product_id_1 = sq.product_id_1
 AND ob.product_id_2 = sq.product_id_2
ORDER BY seasonal_period_type, store_location, seasonal_period, store_season_cross_tab_frequency DESC, product_name_1, product_name_2
LIMIT 200;

WITH order_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        CASE
            WHEN s.store_name = 'Zava Retail Online' THEN 'Online'
            ELSE REPLACE(s.store_name, 'Zava Retail ', '')
        END AS store_location,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month_period,
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_date)::date AS quarter_period,
        a.product_id AS product_id_1,
        p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
        b.product_id AS product_id_2,
        p2.product_name AS product_name_2
    FROM retail.orders o
    JOIN retail.stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN retail.order_items a ON a.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN retail.order_items b ON b.order_id = o.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id
    JOIN retail.products p1 ON p1.product_id = a.product_id
    JOIN retail.products p2 ON p2.product_id = b.product_id
),
overall_orders AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders FROM retail.orders
),
overall_baseline AS (
    SELECT product_id_1, product_id_2, product_name_1, product_name_2,
           COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS overall_co_purchase_frequency,
           COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT total_orders FROM overall_orders) AS overall_share_of_orders
    FROM order_pairs
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
),
store_month_orders AS (
    SELECT store_location, month_period, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM order_pairs
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
store_quarter_orders AS (
    SELECT store_location, quarter_period, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM order_pairs
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
store_month_pairs AS (
    SELECT store_location, month_period, product_id_1, product_id_2, product_name_1, product_name_2,
           COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS store_season_cross_tab_frequency
    FROM order_pairs
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
),
store_quarter_pairs AS (
    SELECT store_location, quarter_period, product_id_1, product_id_2, product_name_1, product_name_2,
           COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS store_season_cross_tab_frequency
    FROM order_pairs
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
),
month_scored AS (
    SELECT
        'month' AS seasonal_period_type,
        sm.store_location,
        TO_CHAR(sm.month_period, 'YYYY-MM') AS seasonal_period,
        sm.product_name_1,
        sm.product_name_2,
        sm.store_season_cross_tab_frequency,
        ROUND(sm.store_season_cross_tab_frequency * 1.0 / smo.total_orders, 6) AS store_season_share_of_orders,
        ob.overall_co_purchase_frequency,
        ROUND(ob.overall_share_of_orders, 6) AS overall_share_of_orders,
        sm.store_season_cross_tab_frequency - ob.overall_co_purchase_frequency AS deviation_from_overall_frequency,
        ROUND((sm.store_season_cross_tab_frequency * 1.0 / smo.total_orders) - ob.overall_share_of_orders, 6) AS deviation_from_overall_share,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.store_location, sm.month_period ORDER BY ABS(sm.store_season_cross_tab_frequency - ob.overall_co_purchase_frequency) DESC, sm.store_season_cross_tab_frequency DESC) AS rn
    FROM store_month_pairs sm
    JOIN store_month_orders smo ON smo.store_location = sm.store_location AND smo.month_period = sm.month_period
    JOIN overall_baseline ob ON ob.product_id_1 = sm.product_id_1 AND ob.product_id_2 = sm.product_id_2
),
quarter_scored AS (
    SELECT
        'quarter' AS seasonal_period_type,
        sq.store_location,
        TO_CHAR(sq.quarter_period, 'YYYY') || '-Q' || EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM sq.quarter_period)::text AS seasonal_period,
        sq.product_name_1,
        sq.product_name_2,
        sq.store_season_cross_tab_frequency,
        ROUND(sq.store_season_cross_tab_frequency * 1.0 / soq.total_orders, 6) AS store_season_share_of_orders,
        ob.overall_co_purchase_frequency,
        ROUND(ob.overall_share_of_orders, 6) AS overall_share_of_orders,
        sq.store_season_cross_tab_frequency - ob.overall_co_purchase_frequency AS deviation_from_overall_frequency,
        ROUND((sq.store_season_cross_tab_frequency * 1.0 / soq.total_orders) - ob.overall_share_of_orders, 6) AS deviation_from_overall_share,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sq.store_location, sq.quarter_period ORDER BY ABS(sq.store_season_cross_tab_frequency - ob.overall_co_purchase_frequency) DESC, sq.store_season_cross_tab_frequency DESC) AS rn
    FROM store_quarter_pairs sq
    JOIN store_quarter_orders soq ON soq.store_location = sq.store_location AND soq.quarter_period = sq.quarter_period
    JOIN overall_baseline ob ON ob.product_id_1 = sq.product_id_1 AND ob.product_id_2 = sq.product_id_2
)
SELECT * FROM month_scored WHERE rn <= 5
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM quarter_scored WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY seasonal_period_type, store_location, seasonal_period, ABS(deviation_from_overall_frequency) DESC, store_season_cross_tab_frequency DESC;

Executive summary: The strongest bundle opportunity is Ball Peen Hammer 12oz + Digital Caliper 6-inch, which leads the dataset with 33 co-purchases and a 6% share of orders. Close behind are Ball Peen Hammer 12oz + Tape Measure 25-foot and Finishing Hammer 13oz + Metric Hex Key Set, each at 31 co-purchases and also 6% share.

Top-performing bundle clusters are concentrated around hand tools, measuring tools, and hex key sets:

  • Hammer-led bundles: Ball Peen Hammer 12oz pairs strongly with Digital Caliper 6-inch (33), Tape Measure 25-foot (31), and Locking Pliers 10-inch (27).
  • Finishing/utility bundles: Finishing Hammer 13oz pairs with Metric Hex Key Set (31) and Adjustable Wrench 10-inch (25).
